Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Royce O'Neale?

Royce O'Neale is 33 years old.

Where was Royce O'Neale born?

Royce O'Neale was born in Killeen, Texas.

When was Royce O'Neale born?

Royce O'Neale was born on June 5, 1993.

How tall is Royce O'Neale?

Royce O'Neale is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much does Royce O'Neale weigh?

Royce O'Neale weighs 226 lbs (102 kg).

Is Royce O'Neale in the Hall of Fame?

Royce O'Neale is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position does Royce O'Neale play?

Small Forward.

What is Royce O'Neale's net worth?

Royce O'Neale has made at least $59,312,377 playing professional basketball.

How much does Royce O'Neale make?

Royce O'Neale made $10,125,000 in 2026.

How many rings does Royce O'Neale have?

Royce O'Neale has won 0 championships.

What is Royce O'Neale's Instagram account?

Royce O'Neale is on Instagram at rolls_royce00.

What schools did Royce O'Neale attend?

Royce O'Neale attended Harker Heights in Harker Heights, Texas, Denver and Baylor.

What are Royce O'Neale's nicknames?

Big Meal is a nickname for Royce O'Neale.
